art_direction: 一只抽象玄武岩小鸟由圆身和短喙组成，表面微孔，砂色背景。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Carve an imaginary resting bird from dark basalt as a single compact form. Use a rounded body, a small inward-tucked head, and one short beak projection. Suggest the folded wing with a shallow continuous groove rather than individual feathers. The stone surface should show tiny natural pores and a few smoother worn areas. Set the sculpture against warm sand-colored studio paper, lit softly from above left. Keep its low oval silhouette readable, with no eye jewels, painted decoration, nest, or realistic bird anatomy. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
